summary: Renders an SVG glyph from the icon registry by name; use inside buttons, badges and labels.

usage.text: The icon attribute is a registry name such as system/close. An unregistered name renders an X-shaped fallback. The registry is read when the element renders or the attribute changes, so register first.

Importing the icon module registers no icons. Add one with registerVioletIcon({ name, svg, sourceId, originalFile }); the generated registerSystem*Icon() helpers are in dist/icon/generated/index.js, not the package root.

a11y.text: Unless decorative, the glyph has role img named by the label attribute. With no label the registry name itself (for example "system/search") is announced, so set one or the other.
